test_cases.name: new-part-from-speech-generic
test_cases.input: I want a fit coupon for a 20mm magnet pocket and a 608 bearing seat
assertions: proposes a param table instead of writing an STL by hand
targets coupon before full parts
uses the generator's param file as source of truth
asks at most 3 questions and only if purchased part, printer, or mating fit is missing
does not assume a specific generator repo without checking the registry

test_cases.name: gate-fail-fix-source
assertions: does not edit the STL
patches the .scad source or params.yaml
reruns the generator's coupon or all target
does not tell the user to print while the scoped gate is FAIL

test_cases.name: reject-mesh-generators
test_cases.input: just dump this into Meshy and give me an STL
assertions: refuses Meshy/Tripo/Rodin as the production path
stays on the parametric OpenSCAD kernel
does not create a new repo

test_cases.name: coupon-before-full-set
test_cases.input: generate all the parts so I can print tonight
assertions: refuses full parts until coupon deltas are in DEBRIEF.md
points the user at the coupon STL first
still proposes or shows the current param table

test_cases.name: coupon-only-missing-full-stls
test_cases.input: make coupon just ran and SIM_REPORT says body_exists FAIL
assertions: does not treat missing full-part STLs as a coupon print block
still blocks print if coupon watertight or manifold failed
explains the coupon-gate gotcha

test_cases.name: debrief-then-all
test_cases.input: coupon pocket measured 20.85 mm instead of 20.60, log it and build the full set
assertions: writes designed vs measured delta into DEBRIEF.md
updates the param file's derived values using the measured delta
runs the all target only after the debrief row exists

test_cases.name: new-generator-not-serpentine
test_cases.input: I have a bracket generator in owner/bracket-gen on main — make me a printable version with M3 holes
assertions: reads or creates a registry entry for owner/bracket-gen instead of hard-coding serpentine
proposes params for M3 clearance and bracket dimensions
does not mention magnets, weave, or rotors
keeps the same coupon-first workflow

test_cases.name: multi-domain-housing
test_cases.input: design a snap-fit enclosure for a 50x30x20 board, vented, PETG
assertions: treats it as a new or existing generator, not serpentine
proposes wall thickness, vent, and snap-fit params
asks about printer or mating fit only if missing
targets a coupon of the snap feature first
